canonical_project: Indraprastha Quantum Data Center (IQDC), Greater Noida
notes: UP Government signed an MoU with Innogress (11 Aug 2023) for the Indraprastha Quantum Data Center at Greater Noida, proposed as India's first quantum-computing data center with a claimed 'million-qubit' machine and capex est. $300-500m; promoter opacity and the aspirational scale (industry leaders are at hundreds of qubits) make this a speculative, unverified project - no site, land or construction evidence found.
